summary: scripts/e2e.mjs now plays the landing in German and checks what can be seen. The landing part passed twice in a row on fresh servers (build, .data deleted, ports free) and the full `node scripts/e2e.mjs` passed once, with no rerun. Nothing was judged in motion, only stills. Game defects seen, not fixed: market goods names stay English under German, undocking at the base puts the ship 738 m up, and the hard-landing shot shows odd streaks in the sky. Nothing is committed, no server is left running.
done: Pilots play in German: an init script writes lang de to localStorage 'primacy2.settings' before the game loads.
Helpers added: P.hud (ground cells, mode line, HUD text), P.english (English words that must not show), P.lookAtBase (mouse yaw toward the base before shots 43 and 47).

New checks: after the drop the HUD shows HÖHE ÜBER GRUND with a number and the notice is the German 'Reiseflug beendet'. The descent is photographed under 320 m (42b-landing-300m) and the HUD then shows height, sink rate and ground speed. The mode line reads GELANDET while landed. No English HUD words after the drop, at 300 m or landed.

Kept all earlier assertions: landed state, hull undamaged, 30 s without movement, lift-off, dock prompt, dock, market, undock, hard landing against the rule, destruction, wreck within 80 m, frame rate.
Item 8: a fold tunnel never seen is a problem again (foldHops pushes it into problems); it already did when I read the file. The journey saw all its tunnels in the full run.
The script prints finding lines at the end (the frame-rate finding was collected before but never printed).

Runs: landing-only pass 1 ended 'e2e ok' EXIT 0; pass 2 'e2e ok' EXIT 0; two more landing-only passes with the final script also exit 0; full run with the final script: 'landing: lander: ok: undocked 750 m from the pad centre', 'landing: frame rate during the descent (10670 frames in 178 s, a second pilot rendering at the same time): minimum 60.0 fps over a second, median 59.9 fps', 'e2e ok', EXIT 0.
Screenshots 40 to 52 are in screenshots/e2e/ (42b is new).
notDone: Nothing judged in motion; all screenshot judgements are from stills.
Landed in cockpit view the nose cannot be turned toward the base with the mouse, so 43 shows the base only as a marker at the left edge; only 47 shows the base.
Pad numbers 2 to 4, pad edge lights and the base at night were not checked; the landing happens in daylight.
tsc and vitest were not run: no package was touched, only scripts/e2e.mjs.
Controller support and new docking rules not touched, as instructed.
verification: Commands: npm run build, rm -rf .data, then PRIMACY2_LANDING_ONLY=1 node scripts/e2e.mjs, four landing-only runs (all exit 0), and the full node scripts/e2e.mjs twice (both exit 0). Ports were free before each run and after the last. Numbers: drop at about 7.0 km, -103 to -105 m/s; HUD at 300 m showed 314 m, 18,5 m/s, 0 m/s; landed with hull 220 of 220, 351 m from the pad centre, moved 0.0 m in 30 s; hard landing at 18.4 m/s cost 31.2 percent of the hull (rule 34.3) in one run and 34.0 percent in the last full run; the 70 m/s dive destroyed the ship, notice 'Am Boden zerschellt.', wreck 12 to 13 m from the last position; frame rate in the descent minimum 60.0, median 59.9 fps with a second pilot rendering. Screenshots opened with Read: 40 orbit: moon half lit, grey-green with dark maria, marker Ezis Ground 5,3 Mm, German HUD, nothing floats. 41 after drop at 6,98 km: cratered olive-grey ground, base marker on a pale round patch, German notice and HUD cells readable. 42 descent at 1,5 km: curved horizon, craters, thin vertical white streaks in the sky (probably space dust). 42b at 318 m: flat horizon, ground dull olive and soft, no base in view, HUD correct, dock prompt already offered 476 m from the base. 43 landed cockpit: GELANDET, lift-off prompt, ground smooth and blurry, no base in view. 44 landed chase: Wisp on the ground with no shadow or contact mark, so I cannot say whether it floats; near ground smeared. 47 at the pad, 39 m up, 190 m from the base: best shot, tower with red beacon, pads with hazard striping and rings, mast lights, sharp and correctly placed; pad numbers not readable from there. 48 docked: German panel but goods names (Iron Ore, Copper Ore, Titanium Ore, Platinum Ore, Silicates, Machinery, Food, Water, Medicine) are English. 49 undocked: HUD says 738 m height above ground. 50 hard landing: hull bar about 70 percent, sky filled with pale diagonal streaks fanning from the top, looks wrong. 51 crash: German SCHIFF ZERSTÖRT panel and insurance text over dark brown ground, whole base visible at left with tower, masts, pad 1 with its number and hazard ring. 52 wreck seen from lander: dust and fire cloud at left next to the base marker. Not opened: 40b, 41b, 45, 46, and the 42b of the very last run.
requests: Owner: decide whether market goods names (Iron Ore and others) are to be translated; they come from data, not i18n, so I did not fix them.
